svg.aria-label: strata-ecs: the ECS for editors and infinite canvases
svg.title: strata-ecs: the ECS for editors and infinite canvases
svg.desc: Four planes stacked like strata. At the bottom, the core: a slab whose top is a table of rows and columns, with one row and one cell marked. Above it, three dashed planes marked opt-in: reactivity, with a ripple spreading from the marked value; document, with the shapes of a board; and presence, with two cursors and a selection. One line runs down through the same shape on all four. The labels read: presence, who is here; document, what is saved; reactivity, what changed; core, the runtime. One runtime under all three.
